text: “Every soul will taste death.”
“Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.”
“For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.”
“Indeed, Allah is with the patient.”
“Indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.”
“Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.”
“Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.”
“And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.”
“Establish prayer for My remembrance.”
“Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing.”
“We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.”
theme: nearness of Allah, Allah sees all

text: “So remember Me; I will remember you.”
“Call upon Me; I will respond to you.”
“Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].”
“And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.”
“So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.”
“So do not weaken and do not grieve.”
“Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant.”
“O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade.”
“They used to sleep but little of the night, and in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness.”
“Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers.”
